pack.summary: Tonight: Math pg. 9, one Spelling Choice Board activity, reading, and the Reading Log. Spelling/Handwriting and Reading tests are listed for Friday, Sept. 18.

subjects.subject: Religion
topics: God is the Giver of Gifts
studyNotes: Jesus is God's greatest gift to us and teaches us about God and how to live.
Jesus gave us the new life of grace.
We are made in God's image and likeness; we can think, choose, and love.
The Trinity is three persons in one God: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
We use our senses to enjoy God's gifts and have a responsibility to care for creation.

subjects.subject: Reading
studyNotes: Sight words include put, why, blue, help, for, yellow, both, there, even, ball, or, green, how, little, one, see, sounds, funny, find, and could.
Phonics work includes short a, i, e, o, and u.
Reading comprehension work includes visualizing, plot (beginning, middle, end), understanding characters, and captions.
Word structure work uses -s and -es to make plural nouns.

subjects.subject: Spelling
studyNotes: Basic words: went, tell, pet, job, fog, not, tug, hut, tub, bun.

subjects.subject: Math
studyNotes: A Chapter 1A addition test is listed for Tuesday, Sept. 22.
The current Homework page assigns Math pg. 9.
